title: 第15章 紫阳神复活第14章 秒杀
lines: 祭坛顶端，那团搏动着浩瀚生机的翠绿光霞，在皇老那蕴含无上伟力的目光注视下，如同被注入了最后也是最关键的薪火，骤然向内坍缩、凝聚！
光芒不再外放，而是如同亿万颗星辰的核心在疯狂燃烧、压缩！
祭坛九条盘绕的紫晶神龙昂首长吟，古老符文彻底化作流动的紫色光焰，将整个核心渲染得如同孕育着太古神只的混沌熔炉！
咚！
咚！
咚！
一声声清晰而有力的搏动，如同开天辟地的神鼓，从光霞核心震荡而出！
每一次搏动，都引得整个紫曜神域的星辰之光随之明灭，引得祖地的地脉发出共鸣的低吼！
那不再是微弱的心跳，而是沉睡了万古的骄阳，在积蓄着破晓而出的磅礴力量！
紫族所有人的心都提到了嗓子眼，屏息凝神，连重伤的紫幽冥都忘记了疼痛，目光死死锁定那团光芒。
终于！
璀璨到极致的光霞猛地向内一收！
仿佛宇宙初开，奇点爆发！
所有的光芒瞬间敛去，凝聚于一点！
下一刻，一道修长、挺拔、完美无瑕的身影，清晰地、真实地……踏立在祭坛核心！
他身无寸缕，肌肤如同最上等的紫玉雕琢，流淌着温润的光泽，每一寸肌体都蕴含着爆炸性的力量与无穷的生机。
紫发如瀑，自然垂落，发梢还带着点点未散尽的翠绿光屑。
他缓缓地、带着一丝初临人世的迷茫，睁开了双眼。
那是一双怎样的眼眸？
初时，如蒙尘的星辰，带着久睡初醒的懵懂与对周遭一切的陌生。
他低头，看着自己真实存在的双手，感受着心脏有力的跳动，温热的血液在血管中奔流……一种巨大的、不真实的荒谬感涌上心头。
“我……还活着？”
低沉的、带着一丝沙哑的嗓音响起，充满了不确定。
但这份迷茫仅仅持续了一瞬。
那双深邃如同星海的眼眸中，迷茫如同潮水般迅速退去，取而代之的是洞悉一切的明悟与智慧之光！
无数的记忆碎片，如同奔腾的江河瞬间涌入脑海——辉煌的崛起、陨落时的遗憾与不甘、遇到叶无缺时候的惊艳等等……
他的目光，瞬间抬起，带着无与伦比的感激与深深的敬畏，精准地投向了祭坛上空那道巍峨的光影——皇老！
“前辈再造之恩……紫阳神……永世不忘！”
他深深躬身，声音带着重获新生的激动与绝对的恭敬。
若非皇老，他早已是时光长河中的一粒尘埃。
皇老那由纯粹光辉构成的面容似乎没有任何变化，但周身流淌的光芒却微微柔和了一丝，仿佛一个无声的回应。
这细微的变化，已足以让紫阳神感受到那份认可。
旋即，紫阳神那带着激动与探寻的目光，如同实质般扫过祭坛下方一张张熟悉而热切的脸庞。
父亲紫幽冥那饱含热泪、欣慰到极致的目光；
妹妹紫阳仙那梨花带雨、又哭又笑的娇颜；
content_en:
At the top of the altar, the emerald green light pulsating with vast vitality, under the gaze of the emperor's supreme power, seemed to have been injected with the last and most critical fire, and suddenly collapsed and condensed inward!
The light no longer shines outward, but is like the core of billions of stars burning and compressing crazily!
The nine coiled amethyst dragons on the altar raised their heads and chanted, and the ancient runes completely turned into flowing purple flames, rendering the entire core like a chaotic furnace that gave birth to ancient gods!
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Clear and powerful pulses, like the divine drum that created the world, vibrated out from the core of Guangxia!
Every pulse caused the light of the stars in the entire Zi Yao Divine Realm to flicker and extinguish, causing the veins of the ancestral land to emit a low, resonant roar!
It is no longer a weak heartbeat, but the scorching sun that has been sleeping for eternity, accumulating the majestic power to rise at dawn!
Everyone in the Zi clan had their hearts in their throats, holding their breath and concentrating. Even the seriously injured Zi Youming forgot about the pain, and his eyes were fixed on that ball of light.
finally!
The extremely bright light suddenly turned inward!
It’s like the universe was first opened and a singularity exploded!
All the light instantly converged into one point!
The next moment, a slender, tall, and flawless figure clearly and truly... stood at the core of the altar!
He was naked, his skin was like the finest purple jade, flowing with a warm luster, and every inch of his body contained explosive power and infinite vitality.
The purple hair is like a waterfall, hanging down naturally, with a little bit of emerald green light on the ends of the hair.
Slowly, with a hint of confusion as he entered the world, he opened his eyes.
What kind of eyes are those?
At first, like dusty stars, with the confusion of waking up from a long sleep and the unfamiliarity with everything around you.
He lowered his head and looked at his real hands, feeling the powerful beating of his heart and the warm blood rushing through his veins... A huge, unreal sense of absurdity came to his heart.
"Huh?"
"I...am still alive?"
A low, hoarse voice sounded, full of uncertainty.
But this confusion only lasted for a moment.
In those eyes as deep as the sea of ​​stars, confusion quickly receded like the tide, replaced by the light of understanding and wisdom that penetrated everything!
Countless memory fragments flooded into my mind instantly like a rushing river - the glorious rise, the regret and unwillingness when falling, the surprise when meeting Ye Wuque, etc...
His gaze instantly raised, with unparalleled gratitude and deep awe, he accurately cast his gaze on the majestic light and shadow above the altar - Mr. Huang!
"Senior's kindness in reincarnation... Ziyang God... will never be forgotten!"
He bowed deeply, his voice filled with the excitement of rebirth and absolute respect.
If it weren't for Mr. Huang, he would have been a speck of dust in the long river of time.
The emperor's face, which was composed of pure brilliance, did not seem to change at all, but the light flowing around him softened slightly, as if it was a silent response.
This subtle change was enough for Ziyang Shen to feel that recognition.
Immediately, Ziyang God's eyes with excitement and exploration swept over the familiar and eager faces under the altar as if they were real.
Father Zi Youming’s tearful and extremely pleased eyes;
My sister, Ziyangxian, has a beautiful face with pear blossoms and rain, crying and laughing at the same time;
